result:
I added the column and the type field. I haven't run the migration or compiled anything.

- **Migration:** `migrations/003_expert_timezone.sql` runs `alter table experts add column timezone text;`. The column is nullable, so existing rows are fine. I didn't add a check that the value is a valid IANA name. That check would have to happen in app code.
- **Type:** `src/experts/types.ts` now has `timezone?: string` on `Expert`.

I left `saveExpert` in `src/experts/experts.ts` alone, so it won't write the timezone yet. Its `update` only sets name, email and phone. It doesn't set `country` or `hourly_rate` either.

`getExpert` uses `select *`, which returns snake_case column names like `hourly_rate`, while the type uses camelCase `hourlyRate`. That mismatch was already there. `timezone` is a single word, so it maps correctly.

I can add `timezone` to `saveExpert`'s update if you want.
